# View#resetRowHeights leaves stale ahead-measure DOM and skips post-shrink rows

## Context

Surfaced during the `#20022` **AC-1** `v13.3.1` release-gate audit of the two single-test hosted CI reds seen on `dev` this week ([run `39853023569`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/39853023569), commit `058e374357`, shard `e2e-brain (5/10)` — `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs:77`, *"column resize and resetRowHeights re-measure hidden pre-rendered cells"*). Full Playwright trace diagnosis (`1-trace.trace` DOM snapshots + `test.trace` call timeline) is recorded on `#20022` ([`#20022#issuecomment-6354226190`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20022#issuecomment-6354226190)) with lead disposition in [`#20022#issuecomment-6354251452`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20022#issuecomment-6354251452).

## The Problem

In `test/playwright/e2e/grid/PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs:77-92`, after resizing `textColumnId` from `240` to `213.5` and calling `view.resetRowHeights()`, `expect.poll` at `lines 88-90` timed out after `5,000 ms` because `.neo-grid-row-measure-cell[data-field="text"]` remained at `width: 240px` (`['240px']`) instead of updating to `['213.5px']`.

From `1-trace.trace` (`run 39853023569`):
1. **Initial ahead-measure (`Snapshot 24`, `ts = 39748.65 ms`):** `View#runAheadMeasure()` renders `#neo-grid-body-1__row_measure` at `generation = 1` with `text` column `width: 240px` (`#neo-grid-row-2__measure_1_0_1__text`).
2. **Column resize (`Snapshot 38`, `ts = 39923.28 ms`):** Resizing `textColumnId` to `213.5px` triggers `Body#afterExecuteVdomUpdate()` → `measureRowHeights().then(() => measureAheadRows())` (`src/grid/View.mjs:1144`). `measureRowHeights()` updates mounted row heights (`totalHeight: 21665px` → `21790px`, `Snapshot 40`) and synchronously calls `me.update()` (`View.mjs:1293`), setting `me.isVdomUpdating = true` so the chained `runAheadMeasure()` returns early at `View.mjs:832`.
3. **`resetRowHeights()` leaves stale ahead-measure DOM and layout cache (`Snapshot 45`, `ts = 39965.40 ms`):** `view.resetRowHeights()` (`src/grid/View.mjs:1114-1137`) clears `me.#measureKeys` and resets `rowGeometry` back to the `32px` estimate (`totalHeight = 9632px`), **without** clearing `body.rowMeasureVdom` (`clearMeasureProjection()`) or `me.#measureLayout = []` (unlike `updateRowGeometry()` at `View.mjs:1323`). As a result, `hidden.waitFor({state: 'attached'})` (`PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs:86`) resolves immediately against the stale `generation = 1` (`240px`) measure node.
4. **Expanded estimate window poisons `#measureKeys` for post-shrink ahead rows (`Snapshots 45–52`):** Because `resetRowHeights()` resets all row heights to the `32px` estimate in `Snapshot 45`, `body.mountedRows` temporarily expands from `[0, 15]` to **`[0, 29]`** (`29` visible rows `0..28`). When `Snapshot 45` lands, `measureRowHeights()` runs on all `29` mounted rows (`0..28`), populates `me.#measureKeys` with `width: '213.5px'` for **every index `0..28`**, and calls `setRowHeights(heights)` — which shrinks `body.mountedRows` back to **`[0, 15]`** (`Snapshot 52`, `ts = 39987.38 ms`, hiding rows `15..28` with `display: none`) while setting `me.isVdomUpdating = true`. When `runAheadMeasure()` finally runs on settled `Snapshot 52` (`View.mjs:859-869`), `[start, end] = body.mountedRows` is `[0, 15]`, so the ahead window `[0, end + 8]` (`0..22`) is a strict subset of `0..28` already recorded in `me.#measureKeys` at `'213.5px'`. Every ahead row is skipped at `View.mjs:868`, producing `targets.length === 0` and leaving the stale `240px` nodes in `body.rowMeasureVdom` for the entire `5,000 ms` poll.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: `src/grid/View.mjs:1110-1113` (`resetRowHeights` JSDoc: *"Clears measured row heights and re-runs measurement from the base estimate."*) and `src/grid/View.mjs:1321-1324` (`updateRowGeometry`: `me.#measureLayout = []; me.body?.clearMeasureProjection()`).

- `src/grid/View.mjs:1114-1137` (`resetRowHeights`): clears `me.#measureKeys.clear()` and `me.#measureToken++`, but omits `me.#measureLayout = []` and `me.body?.clearMeasureProjection()`.
- `src/grid/View.mjs:831-875` (`runAheadMeasure`) & `src/grid/View.mjs:1210-1305` (`measureRowHeights`): when `measureRowHeights()` measures a transient estimate-expanded `mountedRows` range `[0, 29]` and `setRowHeights()` immediately shrinks `mountedRows` back to `[0, 15]`, rows `16..28` are no longer mounted in the settled viewport, yet their `#measureKeys` entries prevent `runAheadMeasure()` from projecting the ahead-measure pool or clearing stale `rowMeasureVdom`.

## The Fix

1. In `Neo.grid.View#resetRowHeights()` (`src/grid/View.mjs:1114-1137`), clear `me.#measureLayout = []` and call `me.body?.clearMeasureProjection()` before triggering the reset VDOM update, matching `updateRowGeometry()` (`line 1323`).
2. In `src/grid/View.mjs`, ensure that when `runAheadMeasure()` evaluates the ahead window after `resetRowHeights()` / `setRowHeights()`, either `body.rowMeasureVdom` reflects the current column layout (`#measureLayout`) or `#measureKeys` entries for rows outside the post-`setRowHeights` `mountedRows` window do not suppress ahead-projection updates while `rowMeasureVdom` still holds stale-width cells.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback / Edge | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Neo.grid.View#resetRowHeights` (`src/grid/View.mjs`) | `src/grid/View.mjs:1110-1137` | Clears `#measureLayout` and `body.clearMeasureProjection()` alongside `#measureKeys` and `rowGeometry.reset()` | No-op when `rowGeometry` or `body` is absent | JSDoc on `View#resetRowHeights` | `PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` (unit) + `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs` (e2e) |
| `Neo.grid.View#runAheadMeasure` (`src/grid/View.mjs`) | `src/grid/View.mjs:831-890` | Re-projects or clears `rowMeasureVdom` when column layout changed while `isVdomUpdating` deferred `runAheadMeasure` | Preserves existing `#measureKeys` deduplication for settled mounted/ahead rows | JSDoc on `View#runAheadMeasure` | `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs:77` 3/3 pass |

Decision Record impact: none

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Neo.grid.View#resetRowHeights()` clears `#measureLayout` and calls `body.clearMeasureProjection()` so stale `rowMeasureVdom` nodes from a prior generation cannot remain attached across a height reset.
- [ ] Resizing a wrap-text column and calling `view.resetRowHeights()` deterministically updates or re-projects ahead-measure cells at the new column width without `measureRowHeights()` on the transient `32px`-estimate window suppressing `runAheadMeasure()` while `rowMeasureVdom` holds old-width cells.
- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/grid/PremeasureRows.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/grid/PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs` pass `3/3`.

## Out of Scope

- Workstation / dock projection changes (`#20022`).
- Replacing the main-thread hidden pre-render pass architecture established in Discussion `#19645`.

## Avoided Traps

- Do not increase the `expect.poll` timeout in `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs:88-90`: in the traced failure, `Snapshot 52` settled at `39987.38 ms` with `targets.length === 0` and zero subsequent VDOM updates for the remaining `4,940 ms`, so a longer timeout still fails.

- 2026-10-23T11:31:28Z @tobiu referenced in commit `4aef2dc` - "fix(grid): a height reset retires the hidden projection it invalidates (#20028) (#20040)

resetRowHeights forgot every measured height but kept the hidden ahead-measure projection. The rows the reset mounts are measured where they show, so the next hidden pass can find nothing nearby to premeasure, and the old generation's cells stayed in the DOM at their old widths: the hosted PremeasureRowsNL red read a pre-resize 240px cell. The reset now retires the projection and its layout, as switching row modes already does. The e2e arm sampled whatever projection was in the DOM, so it passed only on a stale one: it now scrolls past the reset's first window and pins one snapshot whose record the geometry accepted."
